**Overview:**  
Jaya Prima Travel Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited travel agency focused on umrah and inbound tourism, headquartered in Kuala Lumpur. The company was incorporated on 1 April 1995 and is currently active, with four directors and a top shareholder holding 47.38 % of the equity. Financially, the firm reported revenue of RM 43,292,441 in 2024, but recorded a net loss and a current ratio below 1, alongside an unqualified audit opinion. No legal cases are recorded.
